source.name: SGHP-DT
source.note: Stored current values, not immutable SolveRun results or live plant measurements. Enabled flags alone do not identify fixed specifications: control replacements and formulas also matter. value and displayValue are retained separately; displayValue may be stale.

trust_policy: Ranks 8 (configuration) and 2 (captured output assumptions) are local bookkeeping judgments, not probabilities or sensor quality assessments. Missing uncertainty remains unknown.

config_sghp_condenser_parameters_conduct.basis: Configured U times configured area. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_evaporator_parameters_conduc.basis: Configured U times configured area. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_subcooler_parameters_conduct.basis: Configured U times configured area. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_ihx_parameters_conductance.basis: Configured U times configured area. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_cooling_exchanger_parameters_cond.basis: Configured U times configured area. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_hot_water_pump_parameters_efficie.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_warm_water_pump_parameters_effici.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_source_pump_parameters_efficiency.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_sghp_compressor_parameters_effici.basis: Configured compressor isentropic efficiency; local refrigerant properties remain a surrogate.

config_warm_water_splitter_parameters_fr.basis: Configured fraction for outlet_1, the cooling-exchanger return branch.

config_phnix_power_model_parameters_elec.basis: Configured PHNIX power, not a plant electrical measurement. Mechanical work is treated as aggregate electrical input without an additional motor-loss model.

config_phnix_cop_model_parameters_cop.basis: COP is the platform structural replacement setpoint; Carnot efficiency is manipulated. This is a modelling specification, not a measured COP.

config_source_heater_parameters_heat_dut.basis: Configured electric-heater heat duty, with real platform tag. Electrical efficiency is assumed unity by the system power report.

config_source_pump_parameters_pressure_r.basis: Pressure rise is the platform replacement setpoint; mechanical work is manipulated.

config_warm_water_pump_performance_work.basis: Platform formula evaluates WWVSD / 10 * W to 6 W. Imported as a snapshot of the formula result; no live VSD binding is implemented.

config_makeup_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured makeup pressure; temperature is retained in the reference because this stream interface uses enthalpy.

config_phnix_source_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured source pressure. The platform Air Source stream actually uses water properties.

config_cooling_water_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured cooling-water pressure; zero-duty Pipe CW In is lumped into the boundary.

config_phnix_sink_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured pressure at the platform manual return cut. In the local model the loop is closed.

config_sghp_hot_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of the configured hot-water inlet flow formula (40 * 2.13 mol/s); stored kg/h value. Local closed-loop flow is an alternative specification choice.

config_phnix_sink_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of configured 100 mol/s water at the manual source-return cut.

config_phnix_source_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of configured 500 mol/s water; platform source name is Air Source but fluid is water.

config_cooling_water_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of configured 16 mol/s water.

config_flash_tank_inlet_pressure.basis: Platform pressure replacement setpoint. The saved state is subcooled and has zero steam flow; this is not a steam-producing validation point.

config_hot_water_pump_outlet_pressure.basis: Platform hot-water pressure replacement setpoint; pump mechanical work is manipulated.
